resolution: Loader iso pane is now a fully navigable, smooth editor camera. WASD/arrow pan + Q/E orbit + F recenter (direct key-bus subscription), drag-rotate, wheel-zoom. Pan needed a setTimeout fallback when requestAnimationFrame isn't a host global (a bare rAF call silently never ran). Lag fixed: the loop pushed the camera across the host bridge ~60x/sec even idle — now it pushes ONLY when the pose moves (while panning), since world_loader's pending-camera table re-applies the last pose each render. User confirmed works + no longer lagging.
